No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you understand urban heritage through lakes, neighbourhoods and market life.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • City orientation at public lakeside
  • Old Bhopal market streets
  • Historic architecture from public areas
  • Living urban culture reflection

How the time is spent

  1. City orientation at public lakeside 25 min

  2. Old Bhopal market streets 45 min

  3. Historic architecture from public areas 45 min

  4. Living urban culture reflection 35 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Explain how lakes, neighbourhoods and markets shape Old Bhopal, starting from the public lakeside.
  • Read the old market streets as evidence of the city's urban heritage.
  • Describe historic architecture from public areas and reflect on the urban culture still lived there.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
